title: Multi-Factor Authentication via TOTP
learningObjectives: Understand RFC 6238 Time-based One-Time Password algorithm
Securely encrypt TOTP shared secrets at rest
Design emergency single-use backup recovery codes
keyTradeoffs: App-based TOTP vs SMS/Email verification codes
Grace periods for clock drift (30-second steps vs 60-second window)
commonPitfalls: Storing TOTP secrets in plaintext in the user table
Accepting the same 6-digit TOTP code multiple times within the time step window
transferPrompt: How does session state and token issuance change between step 1 (passphrase) and step 2 (TOTP verification)?
